from typing import List


def filter_by_substring(strings: List[str], substring: str) -> List[str]:
    return [x for x in strings if substring in x]


def test_filter_by_substring():
    # basic match
    assert filter_by_substring(["abc", "bacd", "cde", "array"], "a") == ["abc", "bacd", "array"]
    # no matches
    assert filter_by_substring(["abc", "def"], "z") == []
    # empty input list
    assert filter_by_substring([], "a") == []
    # empty substring matches everything
    assert filter_by_substring(["a", "", "b"], "") == ["a", "", "b"]
    # substring longer than any element
    assert filter_by_substring(["a", "b"], "abcdef") == []
    # case sensitivity
    assert filter_by_substring(["Apple", "apple"], "A") == ["Apple"]
    # match at start, middle, end
    assert filter_by_substring(["xay", "ax", "xa"], "a") == ["xay", "ax", "xa"]
    # exact element match
    assert filter_by_substring(["ab", "abc"], "ab") == ["ab", "abc"]
    # duplicates preserved
    assert filter_by_substring(["aa", "aa"], "a") == ["aa", "aa"]
    # input not mutated
    data = ["abc", "def"]
    filter_by_substring(data, "a")
    assert data == ["abc", "def"]
